column2: Mom asks about Sunday. The card sits right of the dough, and never covers it.
Speak opens the draft. The gist in my words, and the clean reply under it, before anything goes.
Alex can wait. Remove. Two messages left.
Restart the Lens. It remembers what I answered and what I cleared.
What is real: the Lens, every button, memory, and twenty-three LEAF tests. The messages and rewrites are sample data. Voice is off in this preview, so pinch does the same job.
Round two added memory and seventeen new LEAF tests: empty inbox, taps in the wrong phase, reach seated and standing, and a full demo tour. Three full runs in a row. Sixty-nine of sixty-nine pass.
The same moment from across the room. Left, what the glasses show. Right, the counter, the dough, and the card beside it.
